title: Nib shape fidelity: square brush nib sweeps a rotated ribbon (Flash sweeps an axis-aligned square); eraser has no round/square shape option
description:
Two related nib-geometry gaps vs Flash 8 (UNCONFIRMED exact ground truth for the square-nib sweep profile — verify against real Flash 8 before polishing; the missing eraser shape option is a straight docs/04 parity gap).

1. SQUARE BRUSH NIB (StageArea.tsx brushPointsToShape:433-530): with nib='square' the code sweeps the SAME width-constant ribbon as the round nib (offsets perpendicular to travel) and merely flattens the end caps (:495-496, :515-517). A real Flash 8 square brush stamps an AXIS-ALIGNED square along the path: a 45-degree stroke is sqrt(2)x wider than a horizontal one, stroke ends are axis-aligned square corners (not butt caps perpendicular to travel), and corners show the square profile. Only the single-click dab (squareDabPath, :361-373) is correct today. Suggested fix: sweep as a union of per-sample axis-aligned square stamps + connecting parallelograms (the stamp-union construction of task 1426 makes this trivial and also fixes self-overlap).

2. ERASER SHAPE OPTION MISSING: Flash 8's eraser Options offer an eraser-shape dropdown (5 round + 5 square). docs/04-toolbox.md:27 lists 'eraser size/shape' but ToolsPanel.tsx:999+ renders only round sizes; buildEraserPolygon/buildEraserStamp (engine/eraser.ts, engine/planar/eraser.ts:360-401) build disks+capsules only. Add eraserShape to ToolState (tools/types.ts / uiStore DEFAULT_TOOL_STATE), a square stamp builder (axis-aligned squares + bridging quads), and the Options UI.

ACCEPTANCE: square-nib brush diagonal stroke measurably wider than horizontal at equal size, ends axis-aligned (compare to real-Flash oracle screenshot); eraser square shape erases an axis-aligned square footprint; round behavior unchanged. Related: 1426, 1387/1388. Found by brush/eraser Flash-8 fidelity audit.
